description: This file defines the class `TableFrame`, a Java Swing internal frame that manages display, interaction, and data operations for a table view within the RomRaider ECU tuning software. It handles GUI events, manages table registration with handlers, and provides actions for table-related operations, menu integrations, and comparisons.

classes.name: TableFrame
classes.description: An internal frame in the GUI that displays and manages user interactions for a specific Table object, including actions like undo, copy, paste, compare, and table property management, with handlers for internal frame events and menu actions.

methods.name: TableFrame
methods.description: Constructor initializing the internal frame with a title and associated Table object, setting properties, and configuring UI components.

methods.name: internalFrameActivated
methods.description: Handles activation of the internal frame, updating toolbars and menus.

methods.name: internalFrameOpened
methods.description: Registers the table when the frame is opened.

methods.name: internalFrameClosing
methods.description: Deregisters the table when the frame is closing.

methods.name: internalFrameClosed
methods.description: Updates the toolbar after the frame has closed.

methods.name: internalFrameIconified
methods.description: No operation, placeholder for iconification event.

methods.name: internalFrameDeiconified
methods.description: No operation, placeholder for de-iconification event.

methods.name: internalFrameDeactivated
methods.description: Updates toolbar when the frame is deactivated.

methods.name: RegisterTable
methods.description: Registers the current table with the TableUpdateHandler.

methods.name: getTable
methods.description: Returns the Table object associated with this frame.

methods.name: getEditor
methods.description: Returns the current ECUEditor instance managing this table.

methods.name: getTableMenuBar
methods.description: Returns the table’s menu bar component.

methods.name: actionPerformed
methods.description: Handles menu actions such as undo, copy, paste, compare, and table property dialogs; performs appropriate table operations based on menu item selected.

methods.name: compareByTable
methods.description: Sets another table as the comparison table and updates the table view accordingly.

methods.name: refreshSimilarOpenTables
methods.description: Refreshes the list of similar tables opened in other frames.

methods.name: findSimilarTable
methods.description: Finds and returns a table matching the menu item's associated table by file name and name.
